items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I saw a lot of this stuff that was submitted to the band by Lou

ctx.x: So therefore, the arrangements were in the musician's head -- not necessarily on paper. And no one seems to know what happened to those arrangements -- if there ever was such a thing as an arrangement.
But I know that when we were together, and I saw a lot of this stuff that was submitted to the band by Lou, they were pretty skeletal, and they worked the little intricate figures during rehearsal.
And that was to be a very personal thing --
